description: Annotates a copy of the application with moirai provenance from an agreed spec.
instructions: Read the agreed spec and the functions it names. For anything that is not a plain function (an inherited method, a subprocess step, a delete, a key from a local variable) use mode patch, subclass or statement, invalidated, when, relations as the skill describes; try the spec with annotate_preview on a small fixture before annotate_spec. Then annotate_spec, annotate_apply, annotate_validate. Return the spec and the diff for the user to review.
